description:
I’m a final-year BSIT student from Pakistan, interested in Python, AI/ML, data science, and web development. I’m working on Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data, a project using satellite and environmental data to support smarter crop rotation and agricultural decisions.

Looking for teammates skilled in Python, GIS/remote sensing, NASA Earthdata, data analysis, machine learning, or agriculture. Seeking motivated, collaborative people ready to contribute and build an impactful solution!
